name: Camazotz
title: Shadow of Xibalba
summary: Strike enemies with feral strikes decreasing and stealing their turn meter bringing them to Despair.
lore: The “bat of death” is an agent of Omeyocan’s underworld gods, carrying their words and performing their tasks in the lands of the living. As such, he frequently appears not only throughout Omeyocan but in other realms as well—especially lately, as he has entered into some manner of scheme with the dreaded Count Dracula of Vyraj.
archetype_description: Ignore 1% of enemy resistance for each piece of nightweave armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If a target is already under [Drain II], also decrease their Turn Meter by 10%.
Also decrease the target’s FTH and SPD by 5 (stacking up to 50) each time this hero steals Turn Meter.
Each hit is a guaranteed Strong Critical.
